EmailTemplate.description: Email after a student has signed a Transfer Admission Guarantee agreement for ASU.
EmailTemplate.name: TSA Students: "Thank you for signing a TAG agreement"
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for signing a TAG agreement
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for signing a Transfer Admission Guarantee agreement for ASU — your path to becoming a Sun Devil. Now that you are on a TAG, you will know exactly which classes you need to complete to make a seamless transition to your desired major at Arizona State University.
As a TAG student, you can access My ASU (https://my.asu.edu) to view your transfer agreement and other transfer details. You also have access to ASU transfer specialists and pre-enrollment services.
If you have any questions about your TAG pathway or ASU, please contact your transfer specialist, {!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c}, at {!User.Recruiter_Email__c}.
Thank you,
{!User.FirstName}
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
